text:
Maya: Quick sync — follow-ups from the Pegasus postmortem. We had recurring VPC peering flaps and an on-prem NAT probe weakness that caused tenant isolation for a few minutes. I want owners + timelines.
Sam: Short note: observed repeated TCP RSTs from the NAT edge during health checks. Looks like probe timeout is too aggressive.
Jordan: I can take the peering resilience docs and add a fallback/rollover cookbook. ETA: EOD Fri.
Elaine: Taking NAT probe logic and canary plan for Pegasus staging. Will bump retries and add jitter, then run validation. ETA: Tue AM.
Raj: I'll build a synthetic path checker (cross-AZ) and a dashboard alert for asymmetric path withdraws. ETA: Wed.
Sam: Also will validate model-serving pinning for Dedicated customers; want to avoid KV-cache invalidations when we fallback. Quick check expected today.
Maya: Action summary added to tracker: https://tracker.redwood/internal/incidents/PEG-4589
Jordan: Playbook items I'll add:
- explicit routing fallback commands
- model-variant pinning recommendation
- rollback snippet with curl + redis flush guard
PR: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/peering-playbook/pull/150
Elaine: Proposed probe config tweak:
```
probe_interval=8  # increase to reduce flapping
probe_retries=5
probe_jitter=0.3
```
Elaine: Pushed patch to staging branch: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/nat-probe/commit/9b7d2e
Raj: Synthetic job created: `pegasus-peering-synth-v1` will run every 5m and emit latency + path stability metrics. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/d/pega/peering-stability
Sam: Added a short runbook task to check BGP withdraw counts and correlate with peering flaps.
ops-bot: Incident 1861234001 closed by @Maya. Follow-ups created and assigned. :white_check_mark:
Maya: I'll host a 15-minute checkpoint tomorrow 09:30 to review PRs and synth results. If anything slips, post updates here.
Jordan: Noted. I'll drop the playbook diff in this thread once CI passes.
Elaine: Running staging validation now, will post results and any failure logs.
Raj: Synthetic run passed initial run, tagging @Maya @Jordan with the CSV output.
Sam: Quick result from model pin check: pinning recommended for r-xlarge->r-medium fallback, will add to playbook comment.
Maya: Great progress. Thanks everyone — keep this thread updated for any ETA changes or blockers. :pray:
